name: AXM Evidence Chain Recovery Snapshot Placement Foundry
actions: validate an exact retained staging receipt, package manifest, and candidate byte ledger
bind one explicit canonical exports/workshop-packages destination by SHA-256 without exposing the path in receipts
copy only the manifest and reviewed candidate through a private scratch folder and atomic rename
verify the receiver-visible package after rename and retain the original staging root
write a digest-only placement receipt back to the staging root and clean exact owned output after failure
summary: Places one verified evidence-chain recovery package into the exact local folder shape Recovery Center can discover, without previewing or applying it.
notes: Placement-only. The Foundry never calls Recovery Center, creates a restore preview, checks or grants recovery.apply, writes the live recovery target, applies or rolls back data, deletes the retained staging source, installs, promotes, or changes CANON.
